name: PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk
summary: PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk manufactures and sells precision fasteners and engineered components primarily for the automotive industry in Indonesia. It offers bolts, nuts, screws, and rivets; and special components, and pins and collars for use in engine, suspension, brake, frame and chassis, interior, power train, and other applications. The company serves the motorcycle, automobile, automotive components, electrical equipment, and home appliance industries. It also exports its products to Germany, Brazil, India, Thailand, Malaysia, and other Asian countries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in North Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Garuda Metalindo Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Garuda Multi Investama.
